## Ruling recorded — A′: package-registry persistence becomes an always-on core capability under its own name; marketplace browsing stays optional (director seat, decision batch #125 item 2, 2026-09-13)

Maintainer, verbatim (live PM chat, reply received 2026-09-13T02:2xZ), to decision batch #125 presented as `1B·2A′·3A·4A′·5B`: 「同意」.

Derived first from the long-term axis: a package is a first-class persistent entity whether or not the deployment has a marketplace — the shape every mainstream platform takes (an admin-created package does not depend on the store). The execution seat's C (rebuild writable packages from `sys_metadata` rows at boot) avoids the spec constant but gives "does this package exist" a second source of truth and a precedence rule — a heuristic layered over a missing table. A's real objection was the token's NAME (`marketplace` advertising a store that is not there), not the persistence; A′ answers it by splitting. B contradicts ADR-0016 §9.1 and is excluded.

### What is ruled
1. `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`: the package-registry persistence (the `sys_packages` container and its hydration) is carved out of `marketplace` into an always-on core capability named for what it is (the spec seat names it; ⛔ not `marketplace`); `marketplace` keeps only the catalogue / browsing half. `Clause-②: yes` (a published constant changes), contract-review carrier; `platform-capabilities.test.ts` ordering contract and the CLI's `serve-capability-vocabulary.test.ts` move with it.
2. `protocol.installPackage` and `protocol.updatePackage` therefore always find the `package` service on a stock boot; their in-memory-only branches stay as the documented degraded path for reduced hosts.
3. `durable-package.test.ts`'s `makeImpl()` gains the service-ABSENT composition so the pin can express the bug this card found.
4. #5047's "package state across media = ADR-level trade-off" is read by the spec seat before landing: this ruling changes which capability owns an existing medium, not the number of media; if the seat judges an ADR note is owed, it files it (governed surface) rather than assuming.
5. The three probes (Studio writable list, `GET /api/v1/data/<ns>_<obj>`, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/…/published`) agree after a restart — that is the acceptance.

### State
`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `bug` / `domain:engine` / `priority:p2` kept (the spec constant half is the spec seat's sibling PR, ⛔ not a cross-lane rider).

Second, independent reading taken this act: **#18053** — the spec carrier for ruling A′ item 1 — is **`closed` / `completed`**. ⇒ item 1's half has landed as well, so the discharge is broader than the note claimed at the time.

## ⛔⛔ Why nothing caught it — this card had NO `Blocked-by:` line ANYWHERE

⛔ Not in the body, ⛔ not in any comment. The state model requires 「`pm:blocked` + 正文行 `Blocked-by: #N`」; this card had the **label without the line**.

⇒ every unlock scan is a **no-op** on it by construction: there is nothing to resolve, so no sweep — triage's or this seat's — can ever release it. ⭐ **A `pm:blocked` with no `Blocked-by:` is not a blocked card. It is a card that has left the state machine**, and it stays out until a human or a seat reads the prose.

⚠️ **#15831 is in the same class and is NOT released by this act** — `pm:blocked`, `bug`, `priority:p2`, ⛔ no `Blocked-by:` anywhere, newest comment 2026-09-05T12:40Z and it names no blocker. This seat did ⛔ not release it because, unlike this card, **nothing on it states a discharge** — releasing on 「I could not find a blocker」 would be releasing on an absence of evidence. It is named here and on the seat post so it is not lost again.

## ⛔ What this seat did NOT verify

⛔ **The premise was not re-taken.** I released on the *blocker* condition, which is unambiguous; whether the defect (a writable package registered in memory only, its published metadata orphaned) is still live on today's tree is **NOT MEASURED** by this act. ⭐ That is the claimant's dispatch-time duty, and it is stated rather than implied.

⚠️ Scope, from the routing note: items **2, 3 and 5** are this lane's; item 1's spec half was #18053. **Still open and ⛔ not answered by anyone**: the question at `5651690676` — whether item 3 may be delivered independently of item 1. ⇒ a claimant should expect to need that answered, and #18053 being closed may or may not settle it.

## ⭐ This card is RULED — the body's 「Expected — one of」 is SUPERSEDED, ⛔ do not treat it as a menu

The body offers three alternative remedies (persist / refuse-to-publish / surface-in-Studio). ⛔ **That list predates the ruling and is not live.** Decision batch **#125 item 2, letter A′** (comment `5650202813`, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-13T02:23Z) settled it: package-registry persistence becomes an **always-on core capability under its own name**; `marketplace` keeps only the catalogue half.

**Item 1 (the spec half) has LANDED** — carrier #18053, `closed`/`completed`. Verified on `origin/main` this act rather than inferred:

```
packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts:57  'marketplace',
packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts:58  'package-registry',
:50 // `marketplace` and `package-registry` are two capabilities, not one token
:51 // spelled twice (#17676 ruling A' item 1).
```

⇒ **items 2, 3 and 5 are this lane's, and item 2's precondition is satisfied.**

## ⚠️ The open question on this card is resolved BY CIRCUMSTANCE, ⛔ not by a ruling

The spec seat flagged 「whether item 3 may be delivered independently of item **1**」 as unanswered (2026-09-13T15:55Z). ⭐ It no longer needs an answer: **item 1 is landed**, so item 3 is not being delivered independently of it. ⛔ Recorded rather than silently dropped — if a taker finds the question still bites for a reason I have not seen, that is a fork to report.

## ⚠️ Why this card sat still for 7 days — ⛔ not a grading problem

It carried `pm:blocked` with **no `Blocked-by:` line anywhere** (⛔ body, ⛔ comments), while its own newest comment said 「you are unblocked to dispatch items 2/3」. ⇒ every unlock scan was a structural no-op on it. Released by this seat at `5750383983`. ⭐ The lesson belongs to the board, ⛔ not to this card's taker.

## ⛔ NOT verified by this seat — the claimant's dispatch-time duty

⛔ **The premise was not re-taken.** Whether an API-created writable package is *still* in-memory-only on today's tree is **NOT MEASURED** here; the release was made on the blocker condition alone. ⇒ the dev re-derives it by symbol **first**, and `premise_still_valid: false` + `pr: null` is a legitimate terminal report.

## ⚠️ Container note — the harness is STALE, and the drift is hand-carried

`check-harness-current.mjs` exits **1**: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is at `81e12e186f` on `origin/main`, ⛔ not in this checkout. **The drift is ONE line**, measured, and it is a narrowing:

> 认领带 `Clause-②:` 行才照抄进正文行首:`Check Changeset` 读正文不读卡;无则零写,⛔ 不自造。

⇒ this claim **does** carry a `Clause-②:` line, so the instruction is identical under both revisions. ⛔ No other drift on the dev surface. Declared rather than assumed harmless.

## ⚠️ The dispatch order's mechanism assumption was WRONG, and it was mine

`domain:engine#1`, round 7, `session_01NcPSwnmJHczmTu6FG7NMjE`. Written 2026-09-20T15:13Z. Verdict on PR #19385: **ACCEPT as a `Part of` increment, with one patch round** (the changeset, below). ⛔ Not a REWORK. The card **stays open**.

The order this seat wrote told the dev that ruling item 1 having landed made item 2's consequence true — that `protocol.installPackage` and `protocol.updatePackage` *"therefore always find the `package` service on a stock boot"*. **That is false on today's tree.** The dev reported it instead of working around it, and this seat then re-derived the whole chain on `origin/main` `8271c814253fdd2629d3b608b73de14efb67f168` rather than accepting the correction on its word:
